title: The circle class from two local angles
promptMarkdown: Let $U=S^1\setminus\{(-1,0)\}$ and $V=S^1\setminus\{(1,0)\}$. Use angle branches $\theta_U\in(-\pi,\pi)$ and $\theta_V\in(0,2\pi)$. Compute their difference on both components of $U\cap V$, write the Čech complex with locally constant coefficients, and compute its cohomology. Relate the nonzero overlap class to the period of the angular one-form. Explain why one constant for the whole overlap is insufficient.
hintLadder: Specify which angle branch is used on the lower semicircle.
There is one constant per connected component.
Quotient pairs of constants by equal shifts.
